steps.title: What it is
steps.body_md:
It keeps each `Reservation` in the database. [`engine/bookings/apps.py:1`](../../ws0/ws/engine/bookings/apps.py#L1 "from django.apps import AppConfig")

Other code calls it over HTTP and on a timer. [`engine/bookings/client.py:1`](../../ws0/ws/engine/bookings/client.py#L1 "import os")

steps.title: Use cases
steps.body_md:
### Poll for new bookings

**Who:** The scheduler · **When:** Every minute

```bash
bookings poll
```

It asks Acme for new bookings. [`engine/bookings/tasks.py:5`](../../ws0/ws/engine/bookings/tasks.py#L5 "def poll_task():") ([p1h1](#p1h1))

**What comes out:** New reservations.

Based on: [`engine/bookings/tasks.py:5`](../../ws0/ws/engine/bookings/tasks.py#L5 "def poll_task():") ([p1h1](#p1h1))

### Receive a webhook

**Who:** Acme · **When:** When a booking changes

```python
Reservation(guest="Ada")
```

It stores the booking. [`engine/bookings/views.py:5`](../../ws0/ws/engine/bookings/views.py#L5 "def webhook(request):") ([p2h1](#p2h1))

**What comes out:** One reservation row.

Based on: [`engine/bookings/views.py:5`](../../ws0/ws/engine/bookings/views.py#L5 "def webhook(request):") ([p2h1](#p2h1))
